name: zmath_clip_line_segment_to_z_range
description: zMath::ClipLineSegmentToZRange clips a 3D segment against the global lower and upper Z clip bounds, rejecting segments fully outside either side.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs under local manifest zmath_clip_line_segment_z_range verifies the helper and the two clip-Z data symbols with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because x87 status-word comparisons still render as flag-word expressions.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bd720 rejects segments with both endpoints above g_zMath_ClipZUpperBound or both below g_zMath_ClipZLowerBound, then clips lower-bound endpoints before upper-bound endpoints through zMath::ClipLineSegmentPointToZ.
The direct callee zMath::ClipLineSegmentPointToZ is covered by functional target zmath_clip_line_segment_point_to_z.
The native zMath Z-clip smoke verifies trivial rejection above and below the range, lower clipping, upper clipping after lower clipping, and an already-visible segment.
